## MacBat 1.1.2
- **Notarized by Apple.** MacBat is now signed with a Developer ID and notarized, so macOS opens it without the "unidentified developer" warning. - **A single password prompt during setup.** Turning on the Sentinel in onboarding now authorizes the Sentinel, Controlled mode and Low Power Mode together, so switching power modes later no longer asks again. - **Fixed hiding the system battery icon on a new user account**, where the setting did not exist yet and the app reported an error. - **Trilho icon:** the charging bolt now sits outside the battery. - **Icon picker after the trial ends:** locked icons are simply dimmed, without a padlock.
